info.name: The Key to the Secret Book

descriptions.inProgress: I mentioned the book I found at the underground study to #p2111004#. I told her that the book may hold the clue to #p2111002#'s disappearance... then I asked Phyllia for #t4031744#. She seemed hesitant, but she gave me the item in the end. Time to go back to the #bunderground study#k.
descriptions.completed: Looking at the hidden hole, I matched #t4031744# into it, and... the rose engraving on #t04031744# matched the shape of the hole. That's when a light flashed out of the hole. Okay, time to look more into it.
